LanguageData.PFA_Rec1: Every animal can be ticked in an animal pen
LanguageData.PFA_Rec2: Ticked animals are led into the pen and stay there
LanguageData.PFA_Enabled: All animals in the pen list
LanguageData.PFA_Enabled_Desc: In the game only roaming farm animals can go into a pen. With this on every animal is in the pen's list. An animal kind ticked in a pen is led there on a rope and fences hold it; untick it and it is a normal animal again. Needs a restart to turn off completely.
LanguageData.PFA_Pets_Desc: Animals with a master or a bond are not put into the pen even when their kind is ticked – they keep their area and follow their master.
LanguageData.PFA_Roam: Wanders off outside the pen about every {0} days
LanguageData.PFA_Roam_Desc: Like farm animals, a pen animal left outside its pen sometimes wanders off. Colonists bring it back.
LanguageData.MUI_DescOn: The mod sets itself up and works right away. Ideal for new players and anyone who does not want to tweak anything.
LanguageData.MUI_DescOffSame: Custom settings. Still the same as recommended.
LanguageData.MUI_ConfirmOn: Turn recommended settings on? Your changes ({0}) will be replaced with the recommended values.
LanguageData.MUI_Locked: Detailed settings are locked. Want to change them? Turn off the switch above – your values start from the recommended ones.
LanguageData.MUI_ChangedTip: Differs from the recommended setting ({0}). Click to restore the recommended value.
